actionNote.disarmCritical: The opponent loses their grasp on the weapon or object, which flies out of easy reach or lands at the feet of the character.
actionNote.disarmWin: The opponent drops the weapon or object within reach; it may be picked up as a non-Combat Action the following round.
actionNote.disarmed: The opponent loses their grasp on their weapon or object, which drops within reach.
actionNote.disarmedCritical: You lose your grasp on your weapon or object, which flies out of easy reach or lands at the feet of your opponent.
actionNote.evadeWin: The character takes no damage and is no longer engaged.
actionNote.evadeFumble: The character falls and starts on the ground next round; if mounted, they fall from their horse and take 1D6 damage.
actionNote.opponentEvaded: The opponent disengages and is no longer engaged.
actionNote.dodgeCritical: They tuck, roll and spring to their feet. They avoid any damage this round, inflict none, and begin the next round ready to act.
actionNote.dodgeWin: The character avoids taking any damage this round and inflicts none of their own. They start the next round on the ground, weapon in hand.
actionNote.dodgeLose: The character takes all damage inflicted this round. They start the next round on the ground, weapon in hand.
actionNote.dodgeFumble: The character takes all damage inflicted this round, falls, and starts on the ground next round, having dropped their weapon.
actionNote.opponentDodged: The opponent dodges; your attack deals no damage.
actionNote.setSpearHit: The charging opponent (or their mount) is struck; roll the opponent's (or the mount's) damage, adding +2D6 if the spear is wielded two-handed. Excess damage after the horse dies passes to the rider.
actionNote.zigzagCritical: The opponent receives a -10 modifier to their Missile Weapon Skill; the character moves up to full Movement Rate this round.
actionNote.zigzagSuccess: The opponent receives a -5 modifier to their Missile Weapon Skill; the character moves up to half their Movement Rate this round.
actionNote.zigzagFail: No modifier to the opponent's Skill; the character moves up to half their Movement Rate this round.
actionNote.zigzagFumble: No modifier to the opponent's Skill; the character stumbles and loses all Movement Rate this round.
